reasons: Amber: HY credit spread (OAS), CCC credit spread (OAS)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance moderate, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) moderate

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 3.08% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +40bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: IG credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 0.84% (amber ≥1.3%), 5d change +7bp (amber ≥+15bp). IDIOSYNCRATIC: HY stressed but IG calm (HY/IG 3.7×) — looks sector- or flow-specific, not systemic.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+0.9pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 16bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $1.2bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 142 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 89 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is moderately priced. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 16.3 sits at the 32th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 11.1, so implied carries +5.3 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Oracle force majeure notice on New Mexico data center puts loan and lease documents under scrutiny
items.note: A force majeure notice on the Oracle-leased Project Jupiter site raises lease-payment and covenant risk for the roughly $18B of project-finance loans backing it.

items.headline: Oracle-linked $18B New Mexico data center loans quoted at 89-91 cents as placement stalls
items.note: Syndicate banks struggling to place the debt with a wider investor base, amid permitting and litigation delays, is a stressed-syndication signal for Stargate-type financings.

items.headline: CoreWeave plans $3B convertible debt offering; stock falls nearly 5%
items.note: CoreWeave's continued reliance on new debt to fund $31-35B of 2026 capex, after earlier junk-rated facilities and CDS near 855bp, keeps neocloud refinancing risk in focus.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
